standard_prerequisites.name: The morphism pi : S_etale -> S_{etale,big} and its pushforward
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the morphism of topoi pi_S : Sh(S_etale) -> Sh(S_{etale,proetale}) / big etale topos, and the identification pi_{S,*} = i_S^{-1} used in the proof
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the exactness of pi_S^{-1} and pi_{S,*} which is exactly the content of the one-line argument.

core_obligations: Recall that pi_S^{-1} and pi_{S,*} = i_S^{-1} are exact functors (proof lines 21317-21318): the pullback and pushforward along the relevant morphism of topoi are both induced by inverse images, hence exact.

Observe the composition pi_{S,*} composed with pi_S^{-1} is the identity functor (proof line 21318): the unit of the adjunction K -> R pi_{S,*} pi_S^{-1} K is then the identity on each object, giving the isomorphism on H^0 = the object itself.
proof_roadmap: Both pi_S^{-1} and pi_{S,*} = i_S^{-1} are exact, so the adjunction map is already an isomorphism before deriving.
The composition pi_{S,*} pi_S^{-1} is the identity, so the map K -> pi_{S,*} pi_S^{-1} K is an isomorphism.
difficulty_reason: The lemma records that cohomological descent is automatic for the small etale topos of a scheme (statement lines 21307-21314). The proof (proof lines 21316-21320) is two sentences: both pi_S^{-1} and pi_{S,*} = i_S^{-1} are exact functors, and their composition is the identity, so the adjunction map is an isomorphism objectwise even without deriving. H2: the argument is the direct observation that the two functors are exact and compose to the identity.
